milestones.name: Working Linux browser
evidence: Isolated launcher contract passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40124539256 (mock executable only)
Independent source branding strings passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40124841263 (not a compiled binary)
Staged archive with checksum and private-profile wrapper passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40125061263 (mock package only)
Pristine source inventory passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40125494649 (483770 regular files, 3633991406 bytes)
Full-native Linux configuration (non-artifact, Vulpra app basename) passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40126134453
Native full build run 40126828007 terminated around 55-minute compilation timeout; compile succeeded through many C/C++ and Rust units before shutdown. No browser success credited.
Native size and elapsed-time reporting verified on mock browser package: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40132561502 (no real browser measurements yet)
Wayland Weston independent harness and early-exit detection passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40133023153 (mock browser only)

Resumable local source downloader with complete-checkout verification: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/blob/main/ci/vulpra-fetch-all.sh. Offline Git recovery/lock tests passed in an isolated synthetic partial clone; target workstation completion is unverified.

Disabled-test manifest bypass matched workstation fix that progressed beyond the missing mochitest support-file blocker: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/commit/fa5f9454f37406939e804b5191830b126d9c9bdf. Native compilation success remains unverified.
Local native build wrapper with file/profile isolation guards and successful mock regressions: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/blob/main/ci/build-local.sh. It has not compiled the actual browser.

Offline source-retrieval, local build-runner and packaging-smoke mock regression suite passed: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40260188808. This used a tiny sparse CI checkout and synthetic executables; no real Vulpra build or runtime credit.

Local native build log (2026-10-26, source HEAD ee223921): mach reported 'Your build was successful!' and returned exit 0 after 1052s incremental compilation. Original Vulpra runner incorrectly demanded a hardcoded dist/bin/firefox path and returned exit 5 afterward. The native executable path, packaged startup and isolated profile remain unverified; no additional product-stage gate credited.
milestones.status_note: Local full native compiler completed successfully on 2026-10-26 (1052s incremental build, mach exit 0); its wrapper failed solely at a hardcoded executable-location check. Actual binary identification, isolated startup, native package and Wayland smoke still pending. One of five combined product acceptance gates remains credited.

remaining: Produce compiled native Linux binary and isolated Vulpra package
Verify packaged runtime startup and browser behavior
Record compiled size, build time and runtime metrics

notes: Source import passed on GitHub Actions run 40119418469; source archive hash verified.
Original Mozilla .github/workflows/README and pr-handler.yml restored to upstream-base with matching blob SHAs.
main source ancestry includes pristine release root import commit; critical source/license paths verified.

Source tree verified against archive, modulo exact checked CRLF normalization for one upstream JSON file and empty cache folders unrepresentable in Git.
M1 source foundation complete: audit verifies source licensing inventory and flags unresolved Nightly branding as M2 shipping block; no distributable Vulpra binary claim.
M2 mock launcher, mock package and independent source strings are passing. Native build still pending; no product success credited.
Full native build 40120428907 failed at native compilation with unavailable job logs at this check; failure cause undetermined. Rebranded build 40124841229 continues.
Linux full-native configure passed 40126134453. M2 20% reflects one of five explicit gates; overall shipped/browser-functionality percentage remains zero.
CI 40126662777 passed native configure with optional test binaries disabled; separate browser runtime tests remain required.

Build 40126828007 failed after SIGTERM/143 near explicitly configured 55-minute timeout (not a demonstrated compiler error). Removed premature timeout; enabled Mozilla sccache-action v0.0.11 with Firefox --with-ccache=sccache and GitHub cache backend for retry. This optimization is pending CI verification.
Vulpra-maintained GitHub Actions workflows passed actionlint 1.7.12: https://github.com/sguzman/vulpra/actions/runs/40133272668. This is CI correctness evidence, not browser runtime evidence.

Build 40131775964 terminated by runner shutdown with exit 143 despite removal of 55-minute timeout; no compiler error/confirmed OOM. Added two-job concurrency experiment and 45-second resource monitoring for following run. M2 remains unchanged.

2026-10-25: Offline synthetic Git downloader regressions and mocked local build-runner tests passed; neither establishes successful native Vulpra compilation or a complete user-workstation source checkout.

2026-10-25: Lightweight GitHub CI run 40260188808 passed synthetic source interruption/resume, local build runner and staged-package headless mock tests. It did not compile Firefox or verify actual browser behavior.

2026-10-26: Native compilation completed successfully on user workstation according to user-provided build log. CI 40348144467 passed tests for a no-rebuild dynamic-name startup probe and accepting compiler success independently of package layout. Build script fix: 352f456 and mock test: fbd3578. Do not label packaged or runnable browser verified.
